annotations.title: One JSON-RPC call with no provider account (paid, x402)

description: PAID: one blockchain JSON-RPC call on base, base-sepolia, ethereum, solana for $0.0100, no provider account: you name chain and method, we pick the node. Unpaid, it returns the price; pay with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Sei or X Layer) in _meta['x402/payment'] and call again. Feedback: POST /feedback (free). Read daily; no individual reply.

chain.description: Which chain to ask: one of base, base-sepolia, ethereum, solana. You never name a URL -- we pick the endpoint, e.g. base.

id.description: Your own call id, echoed back: a string of at most 64 chars or a safe integer. Omitted means we supply one.

method.description: The JSON-RPC method, e.g. eth_blockNumber. Reads, fee queries and raw-transaction broadcast only: 19 EVM methods, 14 Solana. Anything else is refused.

params.description: The method's params, as the node takes them; at most 8192 serialized bytes. Omit for a method that takes none.
